title: Hollow Lantern
logline: A hollow lamplighter descends the drowned kingdom of Ashmere to relight the Great Lantern before the Gloam swallows the last warm room.

plot.premise: The Great Lantern of Ashmere went dark. Four wardens each hold a cinder of its flame. Wick, a vessel of candle-ash made by the lamp-smith Marrow, must win or earn all four, then choose what the flame is for: to burn one life, to be shared among many, to be given to the dark, or to be ruled by it.

characters.name: Wick
characters.bio: A hollow vessel with a lantern for a heart, made by Marrow from the Keeper's last candle-ash.

characters.name: Dorrin
characters.role: snail trader of ash and ore

characters.name: Quill
characters.role: beetle archivist of the Dim Galleries

characters.name: Lady Ashveil
characters.role: wandering ghost of the Barrow court

acts.title: The Last Warm Room
acts.summary: Wick wakes in Cinderwell, takes a lamp from Marrow and descends into Mossgrave to face the first warden.

do.text: The lamp follows you into the dark.
Defeated foes drop ash. Strike downward on enemies to pogo.
Benches restore masks and respawn the dark.
Briar Grip: cling to and climb walls.
The stair below the well has been sealed since the Keeper left. Go.

acts.title: Water and Bells
acts.summary: The Cisterns and the Foundry teach dash and double jump. Wardens guard their cinders with grief and fury.

do.text: Ember Step: dash through gaps and danger.
Moth Wings: a second jump in the air.

acts.title: Songs Below
acts.summary: Wick follows two cinders down: the Drowned Cantor in the Choir and the Ashen Regent in the Barrows. The world opens, and so does its grief.

acts.title: The Hollow Heart
acts.summary: Four cinders, one lie, and a choice: borrow the flame, share it, surrender it, or take the crown.

do.text: All four cinders are yours. Return to Marrow.

quests.title: Embers in the Dark
quests.summary: Marrow has a lamp and a task: descend to Mossgrave.

objectives.text: Speak to Marrow at the well.

quests.title: The Green Cinder
quests.summary: Reach the bottom of Mossgrave and quiet Mother Thistle.

objectives.text: Rest at the bench in the roots.

quests.title: The Hour Is Struck
quests.summary: Open the cistern valve and quiet the Bellkeeper.

quests.title: What the Bellows Know
quests.summary: Cross the Rustbell gap and light all three bellows to wake the forge.

quests.title: The Song Beneath
quests.summary: Ring the three chimes of the drowned organ and face the Cantor.

quests.title: The Ash Cinder
quests.summary: Take the Barrow Sigil from the foundry stacks and win or earn the Regent's cinder.

objectives.text: Recover the Barrow Sigil from Orrin's hoard.
Take the Ash Cinder, by blade or by word.

quests.title: The Hollow Heart
quests.summary: Four cinders, one lantern, and the dark that waits beneath it.

objectives.text: Return to Marrow with the cinders.

quests.title: Torn Corners
quests.summary: Four fragments of the great map are scattered across Ashmere.

quests.title: Brindle's Lamp
quests.summary: A child's tin lamp lies somewhere in the Thornwild.

objectives.text: Find Brindle's lamp in the Thornwild.

quests.title: The Rubbings
quests.summary: Quill needs eight wall rubbings to complete the Lantern's history.

quests.title: Dorrin's Ledger
quests.summary: Six ember ore settle an old debt.

quests.title: Cistern Glass
quests.summary: Sister Vell wants three shards of cistern glass.

quests.title: The Last Waltz
quests.summary: Recover Lady Ashveil's locket from behind a false wall.

objectives.text: Break the false wall in the lower crypt.

quests.title: Trial of Ash
quests.summary: Three waves in the Barrow colosseum.

quests.title: Cage of Wings
quests.summary: Five lumamoths are caged along the Spire. Free them.

quests.title: The Hush
quests.summary: An old guardian keeps the vault of the Dim Galleries.

gates.hint: Marrow can break the seal once Mother Thistle is quieted.
Turn the cistern valve to drain the lower nave.
A sigil from Orrin opens the Barrows.
The Spire needs a second jump.
Four cinders open the way to the Hollow Heart.
Brass key in the Thornwild den.

n1.say: Up already. Good. The well is the last room in Ashmere that still keeps a fire, and it is a small fire, little one.

n2.say: I made you in the dark and the cold from ash and a stub of the Keeper's candle. You are a wick. Wicks are for burning. Try not to hurry.

choices.text: What happened to the Great Lantern?

n3.say: It went out. All at once, like a held breath. Since then the Gloam climbs a floor every winter. Below, the old wardens keep each a cinder of the flame. Gather four and the Lantern can be lit again.

n4.say: West. Mossgrave. Take this lamp, it will follow you where light will not. Mother Thistle sleeps at the bottom; she was gentle once.

n5.say: Because you are the only thing I could make that does not fear the dark. I will say more when you come back with a cinder.

n1.say: You smell of moss and old smoke. The Green Cinder, hold it up. Yes. Still warm.

n2.say: Take the Rust Seal off the lower stair; I opened it with my own hands. The Cisterns are below, and they are wet.

choices.text: Marrow, did Thistle speak to you before she was a warden?

n3.say: She tended the lamps on the Keeper's stair. We are all made of what we kept.

n4.say: Bring back what you find. All of it.

n1.say: Four cinders. You do not know what you carry. Sit.

n2.say: The Keeper did not vanish. She walked into the Lantern to keep it lit one more winter. When her flame was spent, the Gloam rose. I am the lamp-smith who made the glass she walked into.

n3.say: A flame needs a wick. I built you for that, and I am sorry. But the Keeper left a second way in the Barrow court records; a lantern kindled by many hands needs no single wick.

choices.text: Then we find the second way.
I will be the wick. It is what I am for.

n4.say: Ask every voice in Ashmere to give you a light. Not a coin; a light. The ones you have helped will know what I mean.

n5.say: Then I will light the stair for you. I only wish I had been braver.

n6.say: I made you to live. You were meant to choose.

n1.say: Flutter, flutter, a customer! I chart what is gone and sell what is there. Maps, little wick, maps!

choices.text: I want to help with your map.

n2.say: Room outlines for the ones you have walked, a compass pin, a sketch of the next bench. I am out of ink for the far east.

n3.say: Four fragments of the great map were torn when the Gloam rose. Find them, and I will mend the whole of Ashmere for you.

n1.say: The whole of Ashmere, mended! Stand still, I will draw you in the corner.
Charms are not luck. They are promises to the fire. How many can you keep?

choices.text: Can you make me a notch?

n2.say: Choose carefully. Each charm takes room in your hollow.

n3.say: Three shards for a pin. Wear it.

n4.say: Cistern glass. Three pieces. I cut notches in my own bones from it once.

n1.say: Slow and steady, that is trade. I buy ore, I sell what you cannot carry, I forget nothing I am owed.

n3.say: Six ember ore to a forge foreman who went to Rustbell and never returned. Bring me the six and I will call the debt yours to collect.

n1.say: I dropped my lamp in the Thornwild. I wasn't supposed to go. Marrow says the Thornwild eats lanterns.

choices.text: That is a dangerous place for a child.

n2.say: It has my name on it. B-R-I-N. I didn't finish.

n3.say: I know. That is why I need someone else to go.

n1.say: My lamp! It still has a little light inside. Can I share it with you? For luck?
Hush. Hush. Oh. A reader. No one has read here since the Keeper turned the pages for me.

choices.text: Do you know about the Gloam?

n2.say: Every wall inscription in Ashmere, as rubbings. The Lantern was lit by three hands the first time. Three. Not one.

n3.say: Brilliant. Each tablet fills a gap. The pattern becomes... oh. The Sovereign is not a monster. It is the dark the Lantern was built to hold.

n4.say: Older than the Lantern. Ask it what it wants. Do not ask while swinging.

n1.say: Do you dance? No. How refreshing; the court was full of those who did. I have lost my locket in the crypts, and my partner.

n2.say: Behind a false wall in the lower crypt, if the Regent's men did not clear it. Thank you, little flame.

n3.say: The man now called the Regent. He swore an oath to me and then to the crown, and the crown was heavier.

n1.say: My locket. Two portraits, one scratched. He scratched his own out, you see. The Regent never wanted to be remembered as himself.

n2.say: When you meet him, show him this. Or do not. Either way I can rest.

n1.say: I tended the stair and then the stair tended me. Go back, little wick. I cannot stop growing.
TOLL. TOLL. Who calls the hour?
Another taker of warmth. I forged the flame's first vessel; I will not surrender its cinder to a thing I did not make.
We sang the dark away. We sang until our throats were water.
A wick. Come to take the last of my crown?

choices.text: I come for the Ash Cinder.

n2.say: Ah. She kept it. Show me. Show... Then I have no more reason to hold this crown. Take the Cinder, and take this: the crown of Gloam is not mine to hold, nor yours.

n1.say: Little wick. You carry four small suns into a room that has outlasted every sun.

n2.say: I am not your enemy. I am the quiet the Lantern was built to push back. I will give you rest, for the cinders.

choices.text: Rekindle the Lantern with the cinders. I will be the wick.
Rekindle it with every light I have been given.
Take the cinders. Give Ashmere rest.
I will wear the crown and keep the dark in order.

n_crown.say: It is yours. It was always the only seat left.

n_fight.say: Then you will teach me what a wick is.

entries.title: Ashmere
entries.text: A kingdom built downward, one lit floor at a time. The Great Lantern warmed all of it.

entries.title: The Gloam
entries.text: A quiet that thickens into something that hungers. It climbs a floor each winter.

entries.title: Ash
entries.text: The ash of fallen foes carries the lantern's old warmth. Marrow says it is the only coin the Gloam respects.

entries.title: Mother Thistle
entries.text: Once the lamp-keeper of the Keeper's Stair, rooted by the Gloam and made to grow.

entries.title: Glasswater
entries.text: The Cisterns were built to cool the Lantern's glass. Now they hold the Bellkeeper's grief.

entries.title: Pip
entries.text: A cartographer moth who maps what is gone and sells what is left.

entries.title: The Bellkeeper
entries.text: Rang the hour for the whole kingdom. When the Lantern died, he could not stop.

entries.title: Forgemother Orrin
entries.text: Forged the Lantern's first vessel. She resents the new wick.

entries.title: The Choir
entries.text: A hundred singers drowned in the same hymn. The organ still plays.

entries.title: The Drowned Cantor
entries.text: He sang until the cistern rose. His cinder is a held note.

entries.title: The Thornwild
entries.text: Where the Gloam taught the garden to climb. Brindle's lamp is somewhere in the roots.

entries.title: The Barrows
entries.text: The Ashen Court's burial halls. They still hold court.

entries.title: The Ashen Regent
entries.text: He swore an oath to Lady Ashveil and then to the crown. The crown was heavier.

entries.title: The Lantern Spire
entries.text: The old tower that once carried the Lantern's light to the sky.

entries.title: The Dim Galleries
entries.text: An archive that remembers the first lighting: three hands, not one.

entries.title: Marrow's Confession
entries.text: The lamp-smith made the glass the Keeper walked into.

entries.title: What the Sovereign Is
entries.text: Not a monster; the quiet the Lantern was built to hold back. It is lonely.

entries.title: What the Gloam Wants
entries.text: To be spoken to, not struck.

entries.title: The Wick
entries.text: Made of candle-ash. Meant to burn, or to choose.

entries.title: The Keeper
entries.text: Aurelle walked into the Lantern to keep it lit one winter longer.

say.text: Up. Up. The fire is thin tonight.
Another visitor to my hearth. The bellows have waited a long time.

fx.text: From the Spire you can see the dead Lantern far below.

say.text: Come closer. I have been alone a very long time.

barks.say: Somewhere far above, a bell tolls once.
A held note trembles through the water.
Careful on the stair. The Seal is old.
Hold jump longer to rise higher.

endings.title: Kindled Together
endings.epilogue: Wick carries the Lantern's flame upward, handing it from palm to palm: Brindle, Pip, Vell, Ashveil, Marrow, the wardens' memories. The Lantern burns with many wicks. Ashmere warms, floor by floor, and Wick walks out into the morning that follows.

endings.title: Borrowed Flame
endings.epilogue: Wick steps into the Lantern glass as the Keeper did. The flame catches, holds, and warms Ashmere for a generation. In the well, a small fire waits for the next wick.

endings.title: The Long Rest
endings.epilogue: Wick sets the cinders into the Sovereign's open hands. The Gloam is gentle. Ashmere sleeps, and the sleeping never ends, and no one minds.

endings.title: The Hollow Crown
endings.epilogue: Wick wears the crown of Gloam and keeps the dark in order. The floors are quiet and the doors stay shut. Marrow never says a word again.

items.name: Red Cinder

items.name: Blue Cinder

items.name: Ash Cinder

items.desc: Tolls when dropped.

items.name: Map Fragment
items.desc: A torn corner of Ashmere in Pip's hand.

items.name: Brindle's Lamp

items.name: Ember Ore
items.desc: Warm to the touch.

items.name: Cistern Shard
items.desc: Cuts light into colors.

items.name: Silver Locket
items.desc: Holds two portraits, one scratched out.

items.name: Lore Tablet

items.name: Crown of Gloam
items.desc: Cold, weightless, listening.

items.name: Cartographer's Lens

items.name: Notch Pin
items.desc: Adds a charm notch when used.

items.name: Wicklight

items.name: Swift Flame

items.name: Heartwick

items.name: Ember Magnet

items.name: Long Blade

items.name: Choir Lung

items.name: Hush Veil
